summary.one_liner: A curated, categorized list of free and open-source system administration software, covering areas such as backups, configuration management, monitoring, DNS, identity management, and containers.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list: a table of contents of sysadmin tools with one-line descriptions, each tagged with its license and main languages. Entries are grouped by topic under a Software section (for example Backups, Configuration Management, Monitoring & Status Pages, DNS - Servers, Identity Management - LDAP, Software Containers). Some sections only point to other awesome-selfhosted or Cloud Native lists rather than listing projects themselves. The README also includes sections for licenses, anti-features, and external links. The README shown here is truncated, so the full list of categories is not visible. The Backups section specifically (the one linked from awesome-selfhosted) lists backup tools such as restic, BorgBackup, Bareos, Duplicati, and rclone.
use_cases: looking up self-hosted DNS servers or control panels
selecting identity management and SSO software
discovering open-source sysadmin tools by category
notable: Entries include license and language tags, so you can filter by license or stack at a glance
Covers a wide range of sysadmin areas in one place, from build tools to DNS, LDAP, and monitoring
Some categories redirect to related awesome lists (awesome-selfhosted, Cloud Native Landscape) instead of listing projects
Backups section is the one linked from awesome-selfhosted, listing tools such as restic, BorgBackup, Bareos, and Duplicati
caveats: The README was truncated, so later categories (such as Virtualization, VPN, and Web) are not visible in this summary
Some sections only link elsewhere (e.g., Databases, Cloud Computing, Project Management) rather than listing tools
This is a link list, not software; the entries it points to each have their own install steps
